Hi I’m Melanie The Physio based in Australia.

I would like to bring my bubbly personality into this normally serious healthcare world and provide you with advice and information as best as I can to help you manage your injuries from the comfort of your own home! 

The goal of this channel is first and foremost to provide quality and informative/ educational videos.

In the meantime claiming the title of “Australia’s most famous online physiotherapist! ”- in my family's opinion i already am  🤣🤣🤣

I will make the videos simple to understand :) making it easy to follow in hope that I can help as many people as possible, one video at a time :)

Subscribe to my channel and let’s enjoy this journey to wellness together :)
